fields.label: Description
fields.before:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy and absorbing some of the damage dealt as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy. Only applies when equipped with a polearm.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Polearm Mastery
